notes: Axes: nose toward row 0, tail toward +column. The hull p18 is 4 studs wide and 6 deep. The booklet shows the helicopter side-on, so this is a quarter turn from the booklet's side view.

p18's studs are only partly known. I put p2, p3 and p5 on cells where its studs are known to exist: p2 on the same cells p4 used before, p3 at the front, p5 at the right rear. The remaining plate p4 sits on p5 and p11 on p4. The tower p9/p14/p15/p1 stands on p11 behind the hull. The tail boom p22 passes through p9 to the right, with p8/p10/p19 at its end. The main rotor p6 is on the p1 pin. This is a best guess from the pictures.

The steering stand p13 stands on the black brick p2 at the left rear (both step 1). The windscreen p23 sits over the front plate p3 and projects ahead of the hull, so it does not enclose the stand. p7 rests on the windscreen front.

Pin and axle joins: p10 goes through the p8 pin hole, p19 sits on the p10 pin end, and the p22 axle is embedded in p9 and p8. p6 sits on the p1 top pin. The exact hole positions are estimated, and the hinge pair p14/p15 is folded flat.
Part numbers: 436026 = p17 (camera) with yellow round plate p26; 434926 = p16; 461726 = p19 tail rotor; 4142731 = p6 main rotor. The minifigure is not in the piece list and is omitted.

The clip pieces p16 and p17 attach by clips to the skid sides. They are listed in other_joins and I could not make them touch geometrically, so they may still appear as separate groups. This is a modelling limit, not a separate model in the booklet.

Skids p20/p21 are staggered fore/aft under the hull p18. The black plate p12 sits between them under the hull. Step numbers: p9 is 4, p14+p15 is 5, main step 4 is 6, tail boom p22+p8+p10 is 7, step 5 is 8, camera p17+p26 is 9, step 6 is 10.
